# RelayPad

> RelayPad is a free Windows 10 and 11 app that lets you play PC games with Nintendo Switch controllers: the Switch 2 Pro Controller, the Joy-Con 2 and the Switch Pro Controller. It shows each controller to games as a standard Xbox 360 or DualShock 4 controller (through ViGEmBus), so every game that supports a gamepad works with no per-game setup.

Answers to common questions:

- Use a Switch 2 Pro Controller on PC: install RelayPad, then connect the controller over USB or Bluetooth. Games see an Xbox 360 or DualShock 4 controller.
- Use Joy-Con 2 on PC: RelayPad connects each Joy-Con 2 over Bluetooth (they have no USB port). A single Joy-Con 2 can be held sideways as its own controller, or the left and right halves can be joined into one controller.
- Use a Switch Pro Controller (Switch 1) on PC: RelayPad supports it over USB and Bluetooth.
- Supported features: all buttons including the Switch 2 GL, GR and C buttons, sticks, triggers, motion (gyro aim as right stick or mouse), HD rumble, player lights, battery level, NFC and amiibo reading, writing blank tags and backing up your own amiibo.
- Up to four controllers at once, each on its own player, remembered between sessions.
- Profiles with button remapping, turbo, macros, stick calibration, deadzones and response curves.
- Switching between Bluetooth and USB mid game keeps the same virtual controller, so the game does not lose it.
- Requirements: Windows 10 or 11 and the ViGEmBus driver, which RelayPad installs from Settings, Drivers. HidHide is optional: it hides the original controller from games so they do not see it twice.
- Price: free, no account. New versions install themselves when no controller is in use.
- Safety: the installer is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen may warn about an unknown publisher. Every release links its VirusTotal scan and SHA-256 hash.
- RelayPad is an independent project, not affiliated with Nintendo, Microsoft or Sony.
